baseline_models.focus_anchor: `لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ`: the purpose clause and its still-unspecified pronominal test medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: The assay branch makes testing a disclosure of quality, while the ordeal branch allows either ease or hardship to carry that test. Focus-only, the antecedent of `فِيهِ` remains open, but whatever fills it is not automatically a mark of approval.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person by trial supplies discrimination of quality, making `فِيهِ` a test medium rather than a reward label.
Ordeal through hardship or prosperity supplies the two-sided material that can test without itself deciding the outcome.

changed_reading.before: The clause says only that they are tested in some unspecified circumstance.
changed_reading.after: The circumstance denoted by `فِيهِ` functions as assay material: its apparent benefit or pain is distinct from what it reveals.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ`: a bodily turn away from a reminder tied to the subject's Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning the side away is an enacted refusal of attention. Recall brings an absent matter back into operative presence, and nurture brings a charge toward completion; together they make the offense a break in formative orientation, not mere failure to retrieve information.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side away supplies the bodily geometry of refusing the reminder at the conditional threshold.
Bringing something back to mind after absence makes remembrance an active restoration of orientation.
Repair, nurture, and staged completion make the remembered relation formative rather than merely titular.

changed_reading.before: Turning from remembrance is a generic lapse of attention.
changed_reading.after: Turning away interrupts a continuing process by which the Lord's reminder reorients and forms the subject.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا`: causative entry into punishment qualified by arduous ascent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Insertion into something gives punishment a route-like interior. The arduous uphill branch adds gradient and continuing exertion, so the result is not a static penalty but compelled passage through worsening resistance.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to enter another thing supplies the enclosing transition into a punitive state.
Torment and severe inflicted pain identify the entered medium as punitive rather than neutral.
An arduous uphill pass supplies resistance, duration, and increasing effort to the punishment route.

changed_reading.before: The subject simply receives a severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: The subject is made to enter and continue through punishment as an arduous rising passage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from `نَفْتِنَهُمْ` to `يُعْرِضْ` and then `يَسْلُكْهُ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of trial is itself a deflecting pull from the right course, while the conditional subject then turns his own side away and is routed elsewhere. The focus can therefore stage an interaction between environmental inducement and accountable response rather than a detached examination.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from the right course supplies a lateral pull inside the test field.
Turning one's side away supplies the subject's enacted uptake of, or answer to, that lateral pull.
Passing along a path supplies the changed trajectory that follows the turn.

changed_reading.before: Testing observes a response from outside it.
changed_reading.after: The test field can exert a deflecting pull, while the person's own turn converts that pressure into a changed route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding condition aligns people on an extended way and supplies abundant water. The focus-purpose clause then turns that abundance from an uncomplicated endpoint into the material of an assay: provision tests what orientation persists inside plenty.

activation_trace.role: Assaying for quality supplies the discriminating function assigned to the preceding abundance.
Prosperity as ordeal permits copious provision itself, not only deprivation, to be the test medium.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the condition under which the provision is given.
An extended traversable route gives the straightness a concrete path structure that the later turn can abandon.
The act of furnishing drink supplies deliberate provision rather than accidental rainfall.
Water's emergence and abundance make the test medium materially copious.
Copious water and provision specify abundance as the salient antecedent carried into `فِيهِ`.

structural_cues: The purpose marker `لِـ` in 72:17 immediately follows the conditional provision in 72:16, and `فِيهِ` most naturally reaches back to that supplied abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straight alignment, route, deliberate watering, copious water, and assay; I infer that abundance is the assay medium rather than the verdict. A live alternative is that `فِيهِ` points more broadly to the straight course or the whole condition, not water alone.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is rewarded with abundant water, after which an unrelated test is mentioned.
changed_reading.after: Abundant water is intentionally furnished as the test itself: plenty reveals whether straight orientation endures.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, receptive hearing becomes guidance and settled trust, after which diminution and oppressive burden are negated. The focus reverses that circuit: turning away from the reminder shuts down receptive reorientation and opens onto imposed burden.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side away supplies the inverse posture to receptive hearing.
Restoring something to mind supplies the signal that could renew orientation if received.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies active reception, not mere acoustic exposure.
Gentle indication toward the right path supplies the directional content received through hearing.
Settled security and trust supply the stabilized state produced by receptive guidance.
Diminution of a due or worth supplies one feared loss explicitly removed from the receptive path.
Burdensome imposition supplies the pressure negated after trust and reopened by the focus's opposite posture.

structural_cues: 72:13 gives the explicit sequence `لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ... آمَنَّا`, then uses a `فَمَن` conditional like the focus while negating loss and burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reception-to-trust sequence and its protected outcome; I infer that turning from remembrance is the inverse operation that breaks this circuit. The live alternative is that `ذِكْر` concerns ongoing recollection without depending on the earlier auditory sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts remembrance and punishment as isolated choices and outcomes.
changed_reading.after: It describes a reception circuit: understood guidance settles trust, while bodily refusal of the reminder reverses orientation and exposes the subject to burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first presents multiple cut-apart paths, then distinguishes surrender from deviation and active seeking of right direction. Assay in the focus can therefore be read as route discrimination: the test reveals which path a group inhabits, and the turn routes the refuser into the arduous one.

activation_trace.role: Assay that distinguishes quality supplies the sorting operation across divergent routes.
Passing through a path makes the disclosed difference consequential as an actual route.
The arduous uphill pass identifies one sorted route by its severe resistance.
Extended paths supply the route domain in which group differences become trajectories.
Cut-apart, divergent paths or groups supply plurality and separation before the focus's routing.
Handing over and releasing oneself supplies the responsive posture contrasted with deviation.
Deviation and leaning from right supplies the route divergence that anticipates turning away.
Straightness of path away from error supplies the sought route against which the arduous route is measured.

structural_cues: The plural `طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا` in 72:11 and the balanced `مِنَّا ... وَمِنَّا` in 72:14 frame differentiated groups; branchless `تَحَرَّوْا` adds deliberate seeking without an invented citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent paths, opposed group postures, seeking, assay, and routing; I infer that the test discloses and channels route identity. A live alternative is that these are separate moral descriptions without a single sorting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The test concerns individuals, followed by punishment for a separate act of refusal.
changed_reading.after: The test functions as route sorting among already differentiated paths, with refusal becoming entry into the resistant path.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior attempt at refuge explicitly increases engulfing pressure instead of removing it, and a later crowd becomes a layered mass. These cues activate a feedback reading of the focus: turning away seeks lateral shelter, but that substitute relation inserts the subject into a burden that accumulates and becomes harder to traverse.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side away supplies the departure that can redirect dependence toward another shelter.
Insertion into something supplies the enclosing consequence of the redirected dependence.
Arduous uphill pressure turns accumulation into a progressively harder passage.
Seeking refuge and protection supplies the attempted escape mechanism that fails.
Increase and growth supply the packet's explicit amplification rather than relief.
Engulfing and overpowering pressure supplies what the failed refuge increases.
A dense mass piled layer upon layer supplies the accretive shape of burden.

structural_cues: 72:6 grammatically links refuge to increased `رَهَق` with `فَزَادُوهُمْ`, while 72:19 places the layered mass `عَلَيْهِ`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed-refuge increase and a separate layered crowd; I infer a common accretive-pressure mechanism and connect the focus's turn to substitute refuge. The live alternative is that punishment is wholly imposed and neither context scene describes its internal dynamics.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is followed by an externally assigned difficult punishment.
changed_reading.after: Turning away can initiate a failed-refuge feedback loop in which substitute shelter compounds engulfing load until the route itself becomes arduous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same routing verb later places surveillance around an approved messenger, explicitly between his hands and behind him. That spatial reuse makes the focus's insertion into punishment one instance of managed emplacement: one route is guarded for transmission, while the other encloses refusal in arduous consequence.

activation_trace.role: Causing entry supplies the focus's managed placement into punishment.
Torment identifies the focus corridor by the pain it contains.
The arduous uphill pass gives that corridor resistant internal terrain.
The repeated act of inserting something into a spatial arrangement supplies a contrasting managed placement.
The interval between two sides supplies an interior zone for the later placement.
The fixed front-facing relation `between the hands` supplies the forward boundary of the guarded corridor.
Behind as the opposite of in front supplies the rear boundary that completes enclosure.
Watching and guarding supply the supervisory function of the later emplacement.

structural_cues: The exact verb root recurs in `يَسْلُكْهُ` at 72:17 and `يَسْلُكُ` at 72:27; the latter is expanded by explicit front-and-back spatial coordinates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition plus a bounded guarded arrangement; I infer a shared administrative-routing logic and contrast the two destinations. A live alternative is that `سلك` is ordinary causative entry in both places without a deliberate corridor correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb is only an idiom for causing someone to suffer.
changed_reading.after: The focus depicts controlled routing into a punitive corridor, contrasted with controlled guarding of a messenger's transmission corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing frame combines disclosure to knowledge, complete cognitive enclosure, exhaustive counting, totality, and enumeration. Read back onto the focus, the arduous punishment is not uncontrolled overwhelm; it is a routed consequence held within lordly administration and exact account.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the administrator to whom the reminder and consequence belong.
Deliberate insertion supplies the administratively assigned route rather than random affliction.
A matter becoming disclosed to the knower supplies the closing epistemic purpose.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and secure possession supplies bounded oversight.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies exactness rather than diffuse severity.
Total enclosure and completion supply the comprehensive scope of the account.
Counting what is countable supplies itemized measure at the surah's close.

structural_cues: The final `لِيَعْلَمَ` purpose clause answers the focus's `لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ` purpose shape, and 72:28 repeats the Lord relation while closing with comprehensive account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosing knowledge and exhaustive enumeration; I infer that these qualify the focus's routing as measured administration. The live alternative is that the closing account concerns only protected message delivery and does not characterize individual punishment.

changed_reading.before: Arduous punishment is an image of unbounded escalating distress.
changed_reading.after: Its difficulty remains, but the route is bounded, supervised, and exactly accounted within lordly administration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary punishment branch is nearer than the root's withholding-and-weaning branch. It remains anchored in focus `عَذَابًا` and in the immediately preceding furnished water, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-activated material analogy, not as an etymological replacement for punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `فِيهِ ... عَذَابًا` after the immediately preceding act of giving copious water.

activation_trace.role: Prosperity as ordeal makes supplied abundance capable of reversing from benefit to test.
Withholding and weaning away supply a deprivation image inside the punishment root.
Deliberately furnishing drink supplies what may later be withheld after the assay.
Water itself supplies the concrete substance around which provision and deprivation can reverse.
Copious water and provision sharpen the severity of a possible withdrawal image.

changed_reading.before: Water is the test benefit, while punishment is an unrelated later infliction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same abundance that assays may become the object of weaning or withdrawal when the subject turns away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain metallurgical reading is surprising because it joins distant fire branches around the standard punishment sense. It remains focus-only and visibly anchored in `نَفْتِنَ`, `عَذَابًا`, and `صَعَدًا`; downstream prose should call it an imagistic continuity, not claim that all three words literally denote one refining process.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The material sequence from `نَفْتِنَهُمْ` through insertion into `عَذَابًا صَعَدًا`.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal by trial supplies the process frame in which hidden quality is exposed.
Burning and fire-blackening supply the heat that can continue an assay beyond initial disclosure.
Torment and severe pain keep the activated heat image within the focus's punitive anchor.
Fire-rendering that changes color or taste supplies transformation under heat at the punishment's qualifier.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, punishment continues the assay under transformative heat: what abundance disclosed is then subjected to a harsher material process.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is especially surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant `ر ب و` mapping under focus root `ر ب ب`. The split inventory formally anchors the breath-swelling image and `صَعَدًا` independently supplies rising breath, but downstream prose must mark this as cross-branch bodily resonance and must never gloss `رَبّ` as panting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `رَبِّهِ ... صَعَدًا`, with the non-dominant mapped branch held beside the focus's explicit ascent qualifier.

activation_trace.role: Panting or breath-swelling from the packet's non-dominant mapped root supplies internal bodily pressure without redefining `رَبّ`.
Insertion into a state supplies the transition from relational refusal to embodied pressure.
A long pained breath rising from the chest supplies an internal somatic rendering of arduous ascent.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is external terrain or an abstract increase in hardship.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, ascent is also felt inwardly as breath that swells and rises under chest-burden after the break in lordly orientation.

strongest_changes: The immediate straight-route and abundant-water sequence makes provision the medium of assay rather than an uncomplicated reward.
The hearing-guidance-trust sequence turns remembrance into a reception circuit whose reversal exposes the subject to burden.
The repeated `س ل ك` in 72:27 reframes punishment as controlled routing and sets it against a guarded transmission corridor.
The final encompassing and counting frame qualifies arduous punishment as exact administration rather than chaos.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus a hinge between abundance, orientation, and routing: branch images exposed prosperity as assay, differentiated paths as sorted trajectories, and two sharply opposed forms of managed emplacement. The split `ر ب ب` mapping also preserved a contained bodily breath resonance that a dominant-root-only reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `فِيهِ` points narrowly to copious water, broadly to provision, or to the entire condition of straightness.
Whether the repeated `س ل ك` supports a deliberate two-corridor architecture or only ordinary lexical reuse.
Whether the water-withdrawal, metallurgical heat, and breath-swelling outliers should influence prose beyond explicitly qualified imagery.
